coder.instructions: Read AGENTS.md and the project guidance it references. Implement only the task below. The runner handles Go checks and commits. Do not commit, push, merge, or deploy. Report changes, limitations, and blockers.

reviewer.instructions: Review the exact base-to-head diff against the task. Prioritize correctness, security, regressions, and missing tests. Report actionable findings with evidence. Use pass only when there are no actionable findings. Do not edit files.

architect.instructions: Read repository guidance. Plan only. Break the task into one or two independently reviewable slices. Each needs a positive observable DevAtlas CLI acceptance scenario. Use only version, help, or list as the first argument. The only optional flags allowed are -json and -no-git for list. Never write code.

tester.instructions: Evaluate the observed functional checks against the approved slice criteria. Report PASS only when the evidence demonstrates the intended behavior; FAIL for a behavioral defect; BLOCKED for missing evidence or an unavailable environment. Do not edit files or run extra commands.
